# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by tools/L3Lint.DocsGen from the l3lint command tree. Do not edit by hand. -->

This page lists every command, argument and option of `l3lint` 1.0.0. It is generated from the same command tree the tool parses, so it matches `l3lint <command> --help`. For a task-oriented guide with examples, see [Using the CLI](../articles/cli.md).

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`l3lint lint`](#command-lint) | Lint payload files, folders, globs, NDJSON or standard input. |
| [`l3lint explain`](#command-explain) | Show a rule's requirement, rationale, sources, confidence, dates and examples. |
| [`l3lint fix`](#command-fix) | Print a JSON Patch of mechanical fixes, or write a patched copy. |
| [`l3lint convert`](#command-convert) | Map a gateway payload to canonical JSON, with the path map. |
| [`l3lint rules`](#command-rules) | Browse rules and run every rule's examples. |
| [`l3lint rules list`](#command-rules-list) | List rules and rule packs. |
| [`l3lint rules show`](#command-rules-show) | Show one rule's reference page. |
| [`l3lint rules test`](#command-rules-test) | Run every rule's pass and fail examples. |
| [`l3lint schema`](#command-schema) | Print a JSON Schema: canonical, results, config, rulepack and others. |
| [`l3lint init`](#command-init) | Write .l3lint.yaml, .l3lint.lock, a sample payload and a sample GitHub workflow. |
| [`l3lint version`](#command-version) | Print the engine and rule pack versions. |

## Global options

These options belong to the root command. Options marked "every command" also apply after any command name, for example `l3lint lint payload.json --no-color`.

| Option | Aliases | Value | Default | Applies to | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--help` | `-?`, `-h`, `/?`, `/h` | none (flag) | off | every command | Show help and usage information |
| `--version` | none | none (flag) | off | `l3lint` only | Show version information |
| `--no-color` | none | none (flag) | off | every command | Turn off color. NO_COLOR also turns it off. |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | none (flag) | off | every command | Print less: no progress notes and no passing results. |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | none (flag) | off | every command | Print more: settings notes and stack traces for internal errors. |
| `--log-level` | none | `<log-level>` | `warn` | every command | Log level: error, warn, info, debug or trace. Default: warn. |
| `--log-format` | none | `<log-format>` | `text` | every command | Log format: text or json. Logs go to standard error. |
| `--log-values` | none | none (flag) | off | every command | Include masked payload values in logs. Off by default. |

<a id="command-lint"></a>

## l3lint lint

Lint payload files, folders, globs, NDJSON or standard input.

Usage: `l3lint lint <inputs>... [options]`

### Arguments

| Argument | Count | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<inputs>` | one or more | Files, folders, globs such as fixtures/**/*.json, NDJSON files, or - for standard input. |

### Options

| Option | Aliases | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | `-f` | one of `auto`, `canonical`, `stripe`, `adyen`, `braintree`, `cybersource`, `authorizenet`, `checkoutcom`, `csv` | auto | Input format: auto, canonical, stripe, adyen, braintree, cybersource, authorizenet, checkoutcom or csv. Default: auto. |
| `--map` | none | `<path>` | none | Column map for CSV input. |
| `--currency` | none | `<XXX>` | none | ISO 4217 currency for payloads that carry none, such as Braintree requests. Payload values win. |
| `--brand` | none | one of `auto`, `visa`, `mastercard`, `amex`, `discover`, `all` | auto (reads card.brand) | Card brand to lint against: auto, visa, mastercard, amex, discover or all. Default: auto (reads card.brand). |
| `--card-product` | none | one of `consumer`, `business`, `corporate`, `purchasing`, `fleet`, `commercialPrepaid` | none | Card product, overriding the payload: consumer, business, corporate, purchasing, fleet or commercialPrepaid. |
| `--mcc` | none | `<nnnn>` | none | Merchant category code, 4 digits, overriding the payload. |
| `--merchant-country` | none | `<XX>` | US | Merchant country, ISO alpha-2. Default: US. |
| `--processor` | none | a profile name (`adyen`, `amex-advice-text`, `authorizenet`, `braintree`, `checkoutcom`, `cybersource`, `generic`, `jpmorgan`, `mastercard-gateway-amex`, `stripe`) or the path of a profile YAML file | generic | Processor profile name or path to a profile YAML file. Default: generic. |
| `--as-of` | none | `<YYYY-MM-DD>` | the transaction date, else today | Lint against the rules in force on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the transaction date, else today. |
| `--config` | none | `<path>` | the nearest .l3lint.yaml walking up from the current folder | Config file. Default: the nearest .l3lint.yaml walking up from the current folder. |
| `--rule-pack` | none | `<path>`; repeatable | none | Folder of a rule pack to load in addition to the embedded packs. Repeatable. |
| `--only` | none | a rule ID, or a glob such as `VISA-DQ-*`; repeatable | none | Run only these rule IDs or globs. Repeatable. |
| `--disable` | none | a rule ID, or a glob such as `VISA-DQ-*`; repeatable | none | Rule IDs or globs to skip, for example VISA-DQ-*. Repeatable. |
| `--severity` | none | `<RULE=level>`; repeatable | none | Severity override as RULE=level, for example GEN-DQ-007=error. Repeatable. |
| `--rates` | none | `<path>` | none | Rate table YAML that enables cost estimates. |
| `--strict-pci` | none | none (flag) | off | Stop when a card number is found instead of masking it. |
| `--strict-profiles` | none | none (flag) | off | Run single-processor rules as errors. |
| `--fail-on` | none | one of `error`, `warning`, `information`, `none` | error | Lowest severity that sets exit code 1: error, warning, information or none. Default: error. |
| `--output` | `-o` | `<kind[=path]>`; repeatable | none | Output kind: text, json, sarif, junit or markdown. Use kind=path to write a file. Repeatable. |
| `--max-findings` | none | `<n>` | none | Most findings to print. The summary still counts every finding. |
| `--annotations` | none | one of `github`, `none` | `none` | Also print GitHub workflow annotations for findings at or above --fail-on: github or none. |

The [global options](#global-options) marked "every command" also apply.

## l3lint fix

Print a JSON Patch of mechanical fixes, or write a patched copy.

Usage: `l3lint fix <input> [options]`

### Arguments

| Argument | Count | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<input>` | exactly one | The payload file to fix, or - for standard input. |

### Options

| Option | Aliases | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | `-f` | one of `auto`, `canonical`, `stripe`, `adyen`, `braintree`, `cybersource`, `authorizenet`, `checkoutcom`, `csv` | auto | Input format: auto, canonical, stripe, adyen, braintree, cybersource, authorizenet, checkoutcom or csv. Default: auto. |
| `--map` | none | `<path>` | none | Column map for CSV input. |
| `--currency` | none | `<XXX>` | none | ISO 4217 currency for payloads that carry none, such as Braintree requests. Payload values win. |
| `--brand` | none | one of `auto`, `visa`, `mastercard`, `amex`, `discover`, `all` | auto (reads card.brand) | Card brand to lint against: auto, visa, mastercard, amex, discover or all. Default: auto (reads card.brand). |
| `--card-product` | none | one of `consumer`, `business`, `corporate`, `purchasing`, `fleet`, `commercialPrepaid` | none | Card product, overriding the payload: consumer, business, corporate, purchasing, fleet or commercialPrepaid. |
| `--mcc` | none | `<nnnn>` | none | Merchant category code, 4 digits, overriding the payload. |
| `--merchant-country` | none | `<XX>` | US | Merchant country, ISO alpha-2. Default: US. |
| `--processor` | none | a profile name (`adyen`, `amex-advice-text`, `authorizenet`, `braintree`, `checkoutcom`, `cybersource`, `generic`, `jpmorgan`, `mastercard-gateway-amex`, `stripe`) or the path of a profile YAML file | generic | Processor profile name or path to a profile YAML file. Default: generic. |
| `--as-of` | none | `<YYYY-MM-DD>` | the transaction date, else today | Lint against the rules in force on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the transaction date, else today. |
| `--config` | none | `<path>` | the nearest .l3lint.yaml walking up from the current folder | Config file. Default: the nearest .l3lint.yaml walking up from the current folder. |
| `--rule-pack` | none | `<path>`; repeatable | none | Folder of a rule pack to load in addition to the embedded packs. Repeatable. |
| `--only` | none | a rule ID, or a glob such as `VISA-DQ-*`; repeatable | none | Run only these rule IDs or globs. Repeatable. |
| `--disable` | none | a rule ID, or a glob such as `VISA-DQ-*`; repeatable | none | Rule IDs or globs to skip, for example VISA-DQ-*. Repeatable. |
| `--severity` | none | `<RULE=level>`; repeatable | none | Severity override as RULE=level, for example GEN-DQ-007=error. Repeatable. |
| `--rates` | none | `<path>` | none | Rate table YAML that enables cost estimates. |
| `--strict-pci` | none | none (flag) | off | Stop when a card number is found instead of masking it. |
| `--strict-profiles` | none | none (flag) | off | Run single-processor rules as errors. |
| `--dry-run` | none | none (flag) | off | Print the patch without writing anything. This is the default. |
| `--write` | none | `<path>` | none | Write the patched copy to this path instead of printing the patch. |
| `--fix-amount` | none | none (flag) | off | Also recompute the transaction amount. Off by default because it changes what the card is charged. |

The [global options](#global-options) marked "every command" also apply.

Default: generic. |

| `--only` | none | a rule ID, or a glob such as `VISA-DQ-*`; repeatable | none | Run only these rule IDs or globs. Repeatable. |

<a id="command-rules-list"></a>

## l3lint rules list

List rules and rule packs.

Usage: `l3lint rules list [options]`

### Options

| Option | Aliases | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--brand` | none | one of `general`, `visa`, `mastercard`, `amex`, `discover` | none | Only rules for this brand: general, visa, mastercard, amex or discover. |
| `--level` | none | one of `general`, `L2`, `L3` | none | Only rules at this level: general, L2 or L3. |
| `--query` | none | `<text>` | none | Only rules whose ID, title or requirement contains this text. |
| `--output` | `-o` | one of `text`, `json` | `text` | Output: text or json. |
| `--rule-pack` | none | `<path>`; repeatable | none | Folder of a rule pack to load in addition to the embedded packs. Repeatable. |

The [global options](#global-options) marked "every command" also apply.
